annotations.title: My Sleeper League — your starters beside their Kalshi markets

description: Use for "show my fantasy team" and "what is Kalshi pricing my starters at". Give a Sleeper username (and a league name if you have several): your roster, each starter's opponent and kickoff, OUT and QB-gate flags, and every Kalshi prop strike on him this week with the best price per side. Market data; Pro adds our weekly projection.

league.description: League name (partial) or Sleeper league id, when the user is in several.

sleeper_username.description: Sleeper username (profile → username, not the display name).
